set.description: 规定了原点、正方向和单位长度的直线叫数轴，数轴把数与直线上的点联系起来。
set.name: The Number Line

criteria: 能在数轴上标出整数、小数、分数
能读出数轴上点对应的数
set.description: 会在数轴上画出表示给定有理数的点，并读出数轴上点所表示的数。
set.name: Representing Rational Numbers on a Number Line

criteria: 能用有序数对表示位置
能说明为什么要有顺序
set.description: 用有顺序的两个数表示位置，如（列，行），顺序不同表示的位置不同。
set.name: Ordered Pairs

criteria: 能说明垂直的定义和符号
能用三角尺过一点作垂线
set.description: 两条直线相交成直角叫互相垂直，其中一条叫另一条的垂线，掌握过一点作已知直线垂线的方法及其唯一性。
set.name: Perpendicular lines

set.reason: Perpendicular constructions and uniqueness explain orthogonal projections, but plotting on an existing square grid needs only its given axes. Keep the useful geometry preparation without imposing the full construction workflow.
Each coordinate axis is a number line with an origin, a direction and a unit. Plotting and reading coordinates is impossible without understanding those three elements of a number line.
set.scope: coordinate axes as two perpendicular number lines

set.reason: Each axis is a signed number line, so plotting signed coordinates uses number-to-position interpretation on it.
set.scope: axes as number lines with negatives

set.reason: A point's two coordinates form an ordered pair; swapping the entries generally changes the point.
Translation coordinate rules give a model of describing transformations by coordinate changes. Contrasting adding a constant with multiplying by k aids understanding but is not necessary.
Coordinate homothetic constructions require interpreting point coordinates.
The definition specifies a similarity with concurrent corresponding-point lines.

Coordinate differences require the point-coordinate meaning, while slope is unnecessary. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Reading the coordinates of the two points whose distance is calculated

set.reason: The source explicitly recognizes the formula as Pythagoras.

criteria: 能判断位似并找位似中心
能作出位似图形并写出坐标
set.description: 如果两个相似图形的对应点连线相交于一点且对应边平行，这样的相似叫位似，会在平面直角坐标系中作位似图形。
set.name: Homothety

criteria: 能用两点距离公式计算
知道公式是勾股定理
set.description: 平面上两点的距离等于横、纵坐标之差的平方和的算术平方根。
set.name: Distance between two points

criteria: 能画出坐标系并描点
能写出点的坐标
set.description: 两条互相垂直、原点重合的数轴构成平面直角坐标系，会根据坐标描点并读出点的坐标。
set.name: The Cartesian Coordinate System and Point Coordinates
set.nameZh: 平面直角坐标系与点的坐标

criteria: 能叙述定理
能已知两边求第三边
set.description: 直角三角形两直角边的平方和等于斜边的平方：a²+b²=c²。
set.name: Pythagorean theorem

criteria: 能判断相似多边形
能由相似比求线段
set.description: 各角分别相等、各边成比例的两个多边形叫相似多边形，相似比等于对应边之比。
set.name: Similar Polygons

criteria: 能写出点平移后的坐标
能由对应点坐标变化反推平移
set.description: 点向右（左）平移 a 个单位横坐标加（减）a，向上（下）平移 b 个单位纵坐标加（减）b；图形平移即各顶点同样平移。
set.name: Representing Translations Using Coordinates
